title: Validation profile
description: Vocabulary document selecting the rules, severities and waiver policy that apply for one purpose (design decision ADR-016). Identified by 'profileId' + 'version'. A finding's severity is the severity of its rule in the applied profile. Profile contents are initial vocabulary, not numeric norms.

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of a validation profile.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

version.description: Version of this profile, independent of the standard version.

purpose.description: Purpose the profile is made for.

rules.description: Rules applied by the profile, sorted by 'ruleId'.

waiverPolicy.description: Whether and up to which severity findings may be waived under this profile.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this whole document in canonical form, excluding 'contentDigest' itself.

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.

validationPurpose.title: Validation purpose
validationPurpose.description: Purpose of a validation. 'draft-edit', '1to1-print' and 'sample-cut' correspond to the gate actions 'edit-draft', 'export-1to1' and 'cut-sample'; the other purposes have no 1.0 profile.

profileRule.title: Profile rule
profileRule.description: One rule applied by a profile, pinned by rule ID and version, with the severity its findings get under this profile.

ruleId.description: Qualified name of the applied rule.

ruleVersion.description: Version of the applied rule definition.

severity.description: Severity of the rule's findings under this profile; overrides the registry default.

parameters.description: Open rule parameters, checked against the rule's 'parametersSchema' at the semantic level.

waiverPolicy.title: Waiver policy
waiverPolicy.description: Waiver rules of a profile. Findings of severity 'critical' are never waivable.

allowed.description: True if waivers may be applied under this profile.

maxSeverity.description: Highest finding severity a waiver may cover.
